profile.subtitleJa: アンモン人の王ナハシュの子で、父を悼むダビデの使者が訪れたと記されています。
profile.summaryJa: アンモン人の王ナハシュの子で、父を悼むダビデの使者が訪れたと記されています。

facts.textJa: アンモン人の長たちはハヌンに、ダビデの慰問使節は父への敬意でなく偵察に来たのではないかと疑いを述べます。
ハヌンは使者のひげをそり、衣服を切って送り返したと記されます。
アンモン人は自らがダビデに敵対したと知り、軍勢を雇ったと記されます。

primaryWitnesses.textualBasisJa: David said, “I will show kindness to Hanun the son of Nahash, because his father showed kindness to me.” So David sent messengers to comfort him concerning his father. David’s servants came into the land of the children of Ammon to Hanun to comfort him.

But the princes of the children of Ammon said to Hanun, “Do you think that David honors your father, in that he has sent comforters to you? Haven’t his servants come to you to search, to overthrow, and to spy out the land?”
So Hanun took David’s servants, shaved them, and cut off their garments in the middle at their buttocks, and sent them away.

When the children of Ammon saw that they had made themselves odious to David, Hanun and the children of Ammon sent one thousand talents of silver to hire chariots and horsemen out of Mesopotamia, out of Aram-maacah, and out of Zobah.
